text: Implemented reusable ChunkProgram, CompletedChunk, ChunkReducer, and sequential/Future generic chunk interpreters. FitChunkProgram now wraps ChunkProgram[FitChunkWork]; FitChunkReducer centralizes deterministic ordinal merge; chunk execution wraps failures as FitError.ChunkFailed(chunkOrdinal, cause). Verification: sbt fitJVM/test passed 92 tests; sbt fitJS/test passed 89 tests; reserved tracked diff passed git diff --check.
